title: KPI ecosystem refraction — weekly check-in (personal scratch)
content:
Purpose / framing:
- Quick personal instrument for tracking 3 active objectives + leading indicators. Lightweight, noisy intentionally.
- Goal: prevent drift between what I think matters and what actually moves (metrics + behaviors).

This week snapshot (2026-03-10):
- Obj A: Improve onboarding dev experience for plugin integration
  - Outcome target (Q2): reduce median time-to-first-success from 2 hours -> 45 minutes
  - Leading indicators I'm watching: number of devs completing tutorial, time spent in step 2, tickets stuck >24h
  - This week: tutorial completion +3 (total 18), step-2 avg time down 14% (30m -> 26m), 2 tickets stuck >24h (down from 5)
  - Notes: small wins from README reordering. Need to add quick troubleshooting checklist to reduce the remaining stuck tickets.

- Obj B: Personal clarity + deep work cadence
  - Outcome target: 6 focused hours / week on design & code without context-switching
  - Leading indicators: number of uninterrupted blocks (>=60m), inbox count at EOD, weekly reflection completed
  - This week: 3 blocks >=60m, inbox at EOD 42 (target <30), reflection missed Tues (interrupted)
  - Notes: Experiment with 90-min deep block on Friday morning. Try turning off slack notifications for two blocks.

- Obj C: Ship low-cost eval harness for model selection
  - Outcome target: 4 benchmarked candidate configs by end of March
  - Leading indicators: daily run success rate, cost per eval, variance in metric X
  - This week: 1 new config added, daily runs flaky (~70% success), cost per eval trending +8% due to runaway mem spikes
  - Notes: add mem limits, add a small watchdog cron to restart failed runs. Revisit dataset sampling rate.

Micro-OKR draft (one-line atoms):
- O: Make onboarding frictionless for first-time plugin users
  - KR1: tutorial completion >= 70% among trial cohort
  - KR2: reduce 24h stuck tickets from 10 -> 2
  - KR3: NPS for onboarding >= +30 (qualitative)

- O: Protect deep work as a product feature of my week
  - KR1: 6 blocks >= 60 minutes each per week
  - KR2: inbox at EOD <= 30 (measured Fri 5pm)

- O: Get reliable, low-cost eval loop to inform model routing choices
  - KR1: 4 candidate configs benchmarked (latency/cost/quality)
  - KR2: daily eval success >= 95%

Quick retro (what surprised me):
- Small copy and ordering changes had outsized effect on step-2 times — shows product copy = optimization lever.
- My expectations for deep work cadence are often optimistic; meetings creep into blocks.
- Eval harness fragility is mostly infra (OOMs) not model mismatch.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Do I push narrower tutorial (less features) for faster signal, or keep broad and accept longer TTFS? Pros/cons sketched below.
- Which experiment has priority if bandwidth drops to 60%: onboarding checklist vs eval mem fixes? (lean to checklist: immediate user impact)

To-do (next 7 days):
- Draft 1-page troubleshooting checklist for onboarding (by Wed) [PR: WIP]
- Toggle slack DND during two deep blocks (this week)
- Add kill-switch to eval harness (limit mem, restart policy) (tech spike, Thu)
- Short postmortem for the two stuck tickets (extract common root causes)

Notes-to-self (messy heuristics):
- If a small UX change materially reduces time-to-success, double down before more infra work.
- Treat deep-work scheduling like infra: set policies (no meetings, DND, calendar buffer). Reassess after 3 weeks.
- For eval harness, prefer reproducibility over exotic performance wins. Stop optimizing until stability at 95% success.

Fragments / half-formed ideas:
- Tiny onboarding "meter": percentage complete + predicted time remaining (client-side heuristic). Quick visual might reassure devs and reduce support tickets.
- Weekly "bandwidth budget" card on Friday: list top-3 planned blocks for next week and what to deprioritize.
- Micro-commit ritual: 1-sentence summary in Slack #personal-weekly every Friday at 4pm (increase accountability).

Links / refs:
- Confluence: onboarding-playbook (CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-1254)
- Jira: ENG-4392 (onboarding stuck tickets backlog)

Random log (quick, raw):
- 2026-03-08 09:12 — noticed step-2 spike, talked with Priya, moved a paragraph up in tutorial.
- 2026-03-09 14:30 — missed a deep block because of sync; schedule conflict with infra stand. Lesson: pre-block reminders help.

End note: keep this file intentionally short and messy. The goal is to surface friction and decisions, not to be a polished plan. Revisit every Friday at 10:00 to update KIs and choose the one cross-week priority.

---
Version history (notes):
- 2025-11-03 initial seed: scaffolded objectives and a few heuristics.
- 2026-01-20 added micro-okr structure.
- 2026-03-10 current: weekly update + infra action items.
